claims.sentence: The forms, periodicity, order, grading criteria, and deadlines for clearing academic debts are defined by separate local normative acts of the university
During current control and intermediate certification, alongside the standard identification level, a control identification level may be used

The specific forms, periodicity, order, tools, grading criteria, and grading system for current control are developed independently by your instructor and documented in the working program of the discipline or module
You may encounter the following formats when using electronic learning and distance educational technologies
completing parts of a software product code online
completing independent or homework assignments online
completing practical and laboratory works online or offline
completing projects online or offline
taking tests online or offline
attending colloquiums online or offline
taking tests online
submitting reports, essays, references, or reviews online or offline
participating in oral exams online or offline
joining discussions, training sessions, or round tables online or offline
other formats established by your instructor according to the curriculum and academic schedule online or offline

Your instructor will enter the stages and results of your actual mastery into the electronic journal in the Moodle learning management system on the university portal within five working days after the assessment
Intermediate certification is conducted in a format defined by your academic curriculum
The official forms of intermediate certification are the credit (including the differentiated credit) and the exam
Your instructor, practice supervisor, or research supervisor independently determines the specific format and records it in the relevant working program, practice program, or research program
You may encounter the following formats when using electronic learning and distance educational technologies
testing online or offline
oral exams online or offline
written work online or offline
defense of a reference online or offline
defense of a project online or offline
other formats determined by your instructor online or offline

The results of your intermediate certification are recorded in the university's educational information system (Moodle, 1C: University, your student portfolio, or your personal account) within seven working days after the assessment, but no later than the end of the intermediate certification period

For bachelor's and master's programs, your instructor enters the results into a grade sheet on paper or as an electronic document (or a scanned/photographed document with machine-readable recognition), which is submitted to the responsible structural unit
Staff of that unit then transfer the results into 1C: University and may certify them with the dean's signature
The evidence does not specify the exact deadlines for clearing academic debts, only that they are set by local normative acts
The evidence does not detail the specific requirements or procedures for the control identification level, only that it may be used alongside standard identification
The evidence does not list the exact grading criteria or grading system, only that they are set by the instructor and documented in the working program
The evidence does not specify which exact tools or technologies are used for online assessments, only that they are developed by the instructor and documented in the working program
The evidence does not state how results are communicated to you beyond being entered into Moodle, 1C: University, your portfolio, or your personal account
The evidence does not specify the exact dates or periods for intermediate certification, only that results must be recorded by the end of that period
The evidence cuts off before describing the full procedure for PhD program certification results
The evidence does not mention any course-specific pages or how they interact with this regulation, only that this regulation sets the baseline
